title: Ligand relay catalysis: concepts, principles, and applications in transition-metal catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9126-9144
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00806A, Tutorial Review
You Wang, Jingjie Yang, Zhiyong Song, Shuang-Liang Liu, Shaolin Zhu
This review highlights ligand relay catalysis, a strategy that employs dynamic ligand exchange to circumvent the limitations of single-ligand systems, thereby enabling superior reactivity, selectivity, and novel transformations.
